title: A Giant Anteater Has No Teeth. It Has Killed Two Hunters

scenes.text: This animal has no teeth. It killed two hunters.
Brazil, August 2012. A hunter's dogs corner a giant anteater. It rears up on its hind legs, the way they do when threatened.
He doesn't want to shoot near his dogs, so he goes in with a knife. The anteater grabs him with its front limbs.
Its claws are around four inches long, built for ripping open termite mounds. They cut the main artery in his thigh. He didn't survive.
A 75-year-old man in Mato Grosso died the same way in 2010. Both cases were written up in the journal Wilderness and Environmental Medicine.
Seven feet long, nearly blind, and not a single tooth. Still not an animal to corner.

description:
Giant anteaters have no teeth, poor eyesight and bad hearing, but front claws around four inches long. A 2014 paper in Wilderness and Environmental Medicine described two Brazilian hunters, in 2010 and 2012, killed when a cornered anteater reared up and clawed them.
The animals only fight when trapped; both men had approached with dogs.
Which harmless-looking animal would you never corner?
subject: giant anteater
first_comment: Giant anteaters only use those claws when they are cornered; their normal targets are termite mounds. Which animal do people underestimate the most?
